lastCompletedStory.title: Remove the passes:true flip instruction from both implementer prompt copies

nextStoryContext: US-005 was doc-only: reworded the three lines in both subagent-implementer.md copies that told the worker to 'flip passes: true' so they instead say the supervisor is the sole writer (matches ADR 0035 / US-003's finalizeStory). The file-assert oracle `grep -Eiq 'flip .?passes: ?true'` is verb-anchored, not a raw-count check on the literal string 'passes: true' -- see the new patterns.md bullet for the exact regex semantics (it matched 'flip `passes: true`' via the backtick as the optional single char, but does NOT match 'the supervisor flips `passes: true`' or a 'revert `passes: true`' line). Both files still legitimately retain non-imperative mentions of passes:true (schedule/stop-condition prose, the Step 5.5 revert-step wording, which was also reworded per the story's notes even though the oracle didn't strictly require it). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` after editing templates/ (the embed source of truth) since src/vendor/_generated.ts embeds both .claude/settings.json-adjacent agent files; embed-vendor:check is green. NOTE for US-006 (next, requires US-002): US-006 explicitly says to land LAST, after US-003 (done) and US-005 (this story, done) -- so US-006 is now unblocked and is the intended next dispatch. It extends orch-agent-allowlist.sh + settings.json PreToolUse matcher to actually DENY a worker-actor (CAM_WORKER marker) Write to scripts/cam/prd.json at the hook layer, while leaving the planner's (CAM_SESSION without CAM_WORKER) Write to prd.json allowed. This closes the loop: US-003 made the supervisor the sole writer in the production finalizeStory path, US-005 removed the instruction from the prompts, US-006 makes it mechanically enforced so a worker session literally cannot self-flip passes:true via Write/Edit/MultiEdit even if it ignored the (now-corrected) prompt.
